name: lyzn-desktop
description: The LYZN daemon on your own machine — it keeps the promises LYZN heard you make.
author: LYZN

scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:dashboards
scripts.test:chat: esbuild test/clean.test.ts test/toolInput.test.ts test/schedule.test.ts test/receipt.test.ts test/dashboardCards.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.test-build --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && node --test .test-build/clean.test.mjs .test-build/toolInput.test.mjs .test-build/schedule.test.mjs .test-build/receipt.test.mjs .test-build/dashboardCards.test.mjs
scripts.test:dashboards: esbuild test/dashboardDocument.test.ts test/dashboardPaths.test.ts test/dashboardSources.test.ts test/agentTools.test.ts --bundle --external:yaml --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.test-build --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && node --test .test-build/dashboardDocument.test.mjs .test-build/dashboardPaths.test.mjs .test-build/dashboardSources.test.mjs .test-build/agentTools.test.mjs
